stem:
Pihu cannot tell indicator colours apart clearly. Her teacher asks her to test vinegar and soap solution using a change she can notice without colour. Crushed garlic cloves can change smell in acid or base. Red litmus paper is also on the bench.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Crushed garlic can serve as an olfactory indicator for the vinegar and soap solution.
An olfactory indicator gives evidence through a change in odour.
Red litmus paper is suitable for Pihu because it avoids relying on colour.

teacher.key_rationale: Garlic smell change is an olfactory indicator and works without colour. Litmus is a colour indicator, so it is unsuitable when Pihu cannot use colour.
